attBesluta.text: We have had this for a good month now. It’s great to pick up our two Shih Tzu dogs when they get tired walking. The dogs fill the space but they are getting used to having a ride when their legs get tired. The wheels are a good size for pavement or for gravel.
La poussette a l'air très solide, à l'usage "intensif" en vacances à la mer
Täydelliset rattaat, ei paremmat voisi olla! Erittäin tyylikkäät ja kevyet, helppo kasaus. Isona plussana hyvin nopea toimitus!
